text: This report recommends approval of a Rental Housing Demolition application which proposes to demolish 10 rental dwelling units located in a two-storey building at 1212-1238 Kingston Road. The 10 rental units have a municipal address of 1222 Kingston Road, and are proposed to be replaced as part of the new development on the site. The proposal includes a Tenant Assistance Plan that addresses the right of existing tenants to return to replacement rental units at similar rents and provides financial compensation to mitigate hardship. The proposed development on the site at 1212-1238 Kingston Road is the subject of a related Zoning By-law Amendment application (24 214095 ESC 20 OZ). The proposed development would permit an 10-storey residential building with 200 dwelling units, including 10 replacement rental units.
